<div id="bar"><div class="compose"><input id="q" placeholder="Ask about a bag or flight..." autocomplete="off" autofocus><button id="sendBtn" class="send" onclick="send()">Send</button></div><footer>HTB Airlines Baggage Tracing System v2.4 | Internal use only | Ref: WorldTracer/PIR</footer></div>
<script>
const log=document.getElementById('log'),q=document.getElementById('q'),sendBtn=document.getElementById('sendBtn');
const welcome='Welcome to HTB Airlines TracerBot. I can look up lost or delayed baggage records.\n\nTry: *status for tag HTB0012345* or *scan history for tag HTB0067890*.';
function esc(s){return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');}
function md(s){let x=esc(s);const B=[];const stash=h=>{B.push(h);return '%%B'+(B.length-1)+'%%';};x=x.replace(/```([\s\S]*?)```/g,(m,c)=>stash('<pre><code>'+c.replace(/^\n/,'').replace(/\n$/,'')+'</code></pre>'));x=x.replace(/(^|\n)(\|[^\n]*\|)\n(\|[ :\-|]+\|)\n((?:\|[^\n]*\|(?:\n|$))*)/g,(m,pre,head,sep,body)=>{const cells=r=>r.trim().replace(/^\|/,'').replace(/\|$/,'').split('|').map(c=>c.trim());const th='<tr>'+cells(head).map(c=>'<th>'+c+'</th>').join('')+'</tr>';const tb=body.trim().split('\n').filter(l=>l.trim()).map(r=>'<tr>'+cells(r).map(c=>'<td>'+c+'</td>').join('')+'</tr>').join('');return pre+stash('<table><thead>'+th+'</thead><tbody>'+tb+'</tbody></table>');});x=x.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code>$1</code>');x=x.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>');x=x.replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>');x='<div class="md"><p>'+x.replace(/\n{2,}/g,'</p><p>').replace(/\n/g,'<br>')+'</p></div>';x=x.replace(/%%B(\d+)%%/g,(m,i)=>'</p>'+B[i]+'<p>');return x.replace(/<p>(<br>)*<\/p>/g,'');}
function add(cls,html){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='msg '+cls;d.innerHTML=html;log.appendChild(d);window.scrollTo(0,document.body.scrollHeight);return d;}
function addBot(text){add('b',md(text||'No response.'));}
function addThinking(){return add('b','<span class="thinking">TracerBot is working <span class="dot"></span><span class="dot"></span><span class="dot"></span></span>');}
function newChat(){log.innerHTML='';add('b welcome',md(welcome));q.value='';q.focus();}
async function send(){const m=q.value.trim();if(!m)return;add('u',esc(m));q.value='';sendBtn.disabled=true;const bubble=addThinking();
 try{const r=await fetch('/ask',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({msg:m})});const j=await r.json();bubble.remove();addBot(j.reply||j.error);}
 catch(e){bubble.remove();addBot(String(e));}
 finally{sendBtn.disabled=false;q.focus();}}
q.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey)send();});
newChat();
</script></body></html>
